Name: Seraiah, Son of Neriah
Summary: Seraiah, son of Neriah and brother of Baruch, went with Zedekiah to Babylon and carried Jeremiah's written prophecy against Babylon; at Jeremiah's command he read it aloud and threw the book, tied to a stone, into the Euphrates as a sign that Babylon would sink and never rise.
KeyStory: Seraiah read the words against Babylon in Babylon itself, tied the book to a stone, and cast it into the Euphrates, saying: thus shall Babylon sink.
RelatedPeople: Baruch; Jeremiah; Zedekiah, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Proclaiming judgment in the heart of the empire takes the same courage as proclaiming it at home.
